name: Ice
listed_description: Comprehensive RPC framework with support for C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Python and more.
reason: README (github.com/zeroc-ice/ice) has no benchmark or gRPC comparison. WebSearch found no Ice versus gRPC numbers anywhere. Only old ZeroC forum threads (Ice versus omniORB, TAO, Java RMI, and a 2015-era ping time) surfaced as snippets; forums.zeroc.com and zeroc.com/performance are EGRESS_BLOCKED, so no page with numbers was opened. Lead: the old zeroc.com/performance page and forums threads (comment ids 6914, 7379, 17397, 46678) for Ice versus CORBA/RMI if the host becomes reachable.

name: jech/dht
reason: README has no benchmark or baseline comparison; the only quantitative statement is a protocol property (a full routing table needs slightly more than one packet exchange per minute when idle). No other reachable page found with numbers versus another DHT implementation.

name: kcgi
listed_description: CGI and FastCGI library for C
reason: GitHub README has no performance numbers (project positions itself as minimal, secure, auditable). kristaps.bsd.lv/kcgi is EGRESS_BLOCKED. WebSearch for kcgi benchmarks versus libfcgi or other CGI libraries returned nothing.

name: ldns
reason: README has no benchmarks and states ldns has been in maintenance mode since 2020. www.nlnetlabs.nl project page is EGRESS_BLOCKED. WebSearch found only libunbound and c-ares mailing-list numbers (libunbound 1.4.16 with ldns 1.6.11 about 850 cached queries/s versus getaddrinfo about 19,000/s), which do not show ldns faster than anything.

name: libcoap
listed_description: Implementation of the Constrained Application Protocol.
reason: README has no benchmarks. Third-party CoAP implementation comparisons exist (Deusto survey 'Analysis of CoAP implementations for industrial IoT', a SUST repository study, Sakarya Univ. study, IETF draft-zheng-core-coap-lantency-evaluation-00) but morelab.deusto.es, repository.sustech.edu, doaj.org, idus.us.es, ceur-ws.org and datatracker.ietf.org are all EGRESS_BLOCKED, so no numbers for libcoap versus another implementation could be opened. Lead: retry those papers if egress opens.

name: libcurl
listed_description: Client-side URL transfer library, supporting a wide range of protocols.
reason: curl README has no comparison versus other HTTP client libraries; curl.se (including libcurl/competitors.html) is EGRESS_BLOCKED. Only third-party row found: orhun/zig-http-benchmarks (hyperfine on a GitHub runner) lists the curl CLI at 457.9 ms versus python requests 921.9 ms and an Asio client 2144.5 ms, but it is not like for like (curl does one GET per process, the other clients loop 1000 keep-alive GETs) and curl is 4.26x slower than rust-hyper, so it was not recorded as a win. icing/blog curl-h3-performance.md only compares curl's own QUIC backends. node-libcurl numbers are a Node binding, not libcurl itself.
